headline: CHILE RAISES 2026 COPPER FORECAST TO $5.55/LB — Energy Transition and AI Infrastructure Demand Cited
snippet: Chile's copper commission Cochilco lifted its 2026 average copper price forecast to $5.55/lb in its Q1 market trends report, citing firm global demand from the energy transition, EVs, and AI data center buildout. Global refined copper demand is forecast to rise 1.5% in 2026 to 28.2 million metric tonnes, though a projected small surplus of 12,000 tonnes is expected after last year's 124,000-tonne deficit.

headline: SOUTH PACIFIC METALS HITS 9.92 g/t GOLD AND 2.35% COPPER Over 92m in First-Ever Drill Program, Papua New Guinea
snippet: South Pacific Metals (TSX-V: SPMC) confirmed gold-copper mineralization in 5 of 7 holes at Ontenu NE in Papua New Guinea's Kainantu Transfer Zone, with peak intercepts of 9.92 g/t Au and 2.35% Cu in the first-ever drill campaign at the project. Two distinct zones — Onki and Jorkol — have been identified across 2,266m drilled, with two more holes currently in progress.

headline: First Mining Hits 73.4 g/t Gold at Duparquet Abitibi as Three Zones Deliver Final 2025 Program Results
snippet: First Mining Gold (TSX: FF) reported final 2025 drill results from the Duparquet project in Quebec's Abitibi, highlighted by 73.40 g/t Au over 1.0m within a 15.14 g/t envelope over 5.0m at the North Zone. High-grade intercepts were also returned from the South Zone and Minuit Zone targets, confirming multi-target gold potential along the main resource contact zones.

headline: FIRST DRILL AT BIG ONE: Juggernaut Launches Inaugural 10,000m at New Golden Triangle Discovery, B.C.
snippet: Juggernaut Exploration (TSX-V: JUGR) mobilized for the first-ever drill program on the Big One property in B.C.'s Golden Triangle, testing a 22 km² Eldorado system where surface samples have returned up to 263 g/t AuEq across 400+ mapped mineralized veins. The fully-funded 10,000m inaugural campaign targets the most extensive high-grade shear zones in a system with gold visible at surface.

headline: Fortitude Gold Traces 700m Near-Surface Oxide Gold Corridor at Scarlet North, 700m From Process Plant in Nevada
snippet: Fortitude Gold (NASDAQ: FTCO) has delineated a near-surface oxide gold corridor measuring approximately 700m in strike, 200m in width, and 100m in depth at Scarlet North — directly along the Isabella Pearl trend and just 700m from the existing heap leach and process facility. Best hole: 6.10m at 2.28 g/t Au within 24.38m at 1.25 g/t Au, fully oxidized and potentially heap-leachable.

headline: GT Resources Secures DRILL-PERMITTED Gold-Copper Porphyry Near Casino Deposit in Yukon's Dawson Gold Range
snippet: GT Resources (TSX-V: GT) entered a 75% earn-in agreement with Strategic Metals for the drill-permitted CD Project in Yukon's Dawson Gold Range, a gold-copper porphyry target 90km from the Casino deposit with permits valid to 2033. The 2026 season will focus on geophysical data acquisition before a maiden drill program, with the full earn-in requiring $10 million in expenditures by 2030.

headline: Dakota Gold Drills 64m at 1.42 g/t Gold With Infill Holes at Richmond Hill Oxide Heap Leach, South Dakota
snippet: Dakota Gold Corp. (TSX: DC) reported additional 2026 infill drill results from Richmond Hill in South Dakota — including 64.0m at 1.42 g/t Au and 5.97 g/t Ag — advancing its 109-hole, 15,481m campaign toward a Pre-Feasibility Study due in H2 2026. The company is fully funded through PFS with $107 million in cash on hand.

headline: HISTORIC BREAKOUT COMING: Michael Oliver Warns Gold and Silver Primed to Surge as Sovereign Debt Crisis Deepens
snippet: Momentum structure analyst Michael Oliver, writing for Money Metals Exchange, argues the gold-silver divergence of early 2026 is violently correcting and both metals are structurally primed for a historic advance as sovereign debt stress mounts. Oliver targets gold at a minimum of $8,500 and silver at $300 on long-term momentum structure analysis.

headline: SILVER DEFICIT DEEPENS: China Imports 790+ Tonnes in Early 2026, Solar Demand Surges, Gold-Silver Ratio Contracts From 105 Peak
snippet: U.S. Global Investors' weekly Gold SWOT report highlights China's early-2026 silver imports exceeding 790 tonnes — driven by the solar industry and surging retail demand — as the silver market enters its sixth consecutive annual supply deficit. The gold-to-silver ratio's contraction from above 105 in April is a historically bullish signal for silver miners relative to gold producers.
